title: Martha Bakes
description:
S5 E5 — Bake It Dark
Sticky toffee pudding with toffee sauce; mini apricot tartes Tatin; simple pear tart; no-knead bread with flavorful seeds.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S5 E6 — Coconut
Coconut-lemon cake; coconut cookies; coconut crunch cake; frozen coconut and roasted pineapple cake.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S5 E9 — Extraordinary Fruits
Souffle with passion fruit; mango upside-down cake; biscuit-topped raspberry-rhubarb cobblers.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S6 E3 — Chocolate Ganache
Dark chocolate filling for an almond-based tart shell; chocolate ganache frosting for a devil's food cake; milk chocolate pudding cupcakes.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S6 E4 — Sponge Cake
Raspberry whipped cream jelly roll; multitiered caramel buttercream cake; making ladyfingers for tiramisu ice cream cake.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S6 E5 — Frangipane
Incorporating frangipane into bostock and a classic English Bakewell tart; apricot tart made with hazelnut frangipane; pecan-frangipane coffee cake.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E6 — Growing Fruit and Berries
Martha shares tips on the many different varieties of fruits and berries she cultivates on her farm; a lesson on growing raspberries, currants, and blueberries; Matt Kaminsky teaches Martha how to prune and care for her hundred-year-old apple trees.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E1 — Martha's Amazing Maze and How to Grow Trees From Seedlings
Martha's new passion project is the maze she's building on her Bedford farm; she shares her plans and inspiration for the project and teaches the proper measuring, staking and fertilizing techniques to properly plant successful trees.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E2 — Everything You Need To Know About Conifers
Martha shows how to properly move an established tree on her very own Christmas tree farm; she gives a tour of her pinetum where she teaches about new and unusual conifer trees.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E3 — Amazing Houseplants
Martha brings the outdoors inside the home and shares her love of houseplants; she shows how to take care of the most popular houseplants and how to propagate them to create new plants.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E7 — French Bistro Night
Martha gets a first-hand look behind the delicious French dishes at Cenadou Bistro including mussels in a tomato sauce with house-made croutons and a flatbread topped with olives and anchovies.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E8 — The Science of Woks and Frying
Martha and Chef Kenji Lopez-Alt make extra-crunchy fried chicken sandwiches, tempura shrimp with vegetables, and finally a perfectly stir-fried beef with broccoli.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E9 — Perfect Weekend Breakfast
Martha invites Oscar de la Renta co-creative director Laura Kim to her kitchen to create her Instagrammable and aesthetically pleasing recipes.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E10 — Jacques Pepin Cooking His Way
Culinary legend Jacques Pepin brings his authentic French flavors to Martha's kitchen, crafting a delicious, flavorful menu.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S1 E6 — Halloween Party; Caramel Apples; Box Lantern; Cookies
Adult Halloween party; caramel apples; pumpkins.
